title: Get available verification document types for a region
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of supported verification document types for a specific country or region. Once you identify the appropriate business or personal identification documents required for your Business Center or ad account, proceed to upload them using [/account/verification/upload/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/upload-verification-documents/v1.3). ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/account/verification/filetype/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162). | ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |business_type {Required}|string|The type of verification you want to perform.

Enum values:
  • `BUSINESS`: business verification.
  • `INDIVIDUAL`: individual identity verification.
| |region_iso_code {Required}|string|The country or region code for your business (Business Center account or ad account), in ISO 3166 format.

Example: `US`.

  • To retrieve the country or region code of your Business Center account, use [/bc/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-business-centers/v1.3) and check the returned `registered_area` parameter.
  • To retrieve the country or region code of your ad account, use [/advertiser/info/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-ad-account-details/v1.3) and check the returned `country` parameter.
| ``` ### Example #### For business verification ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/account/verification/filetype/?business_type=BUSINESS®ion_iso_code=US' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` #### For individual identity verification ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/account/verification/filetype/?business_type=INDIVIDUAL®ion_iso_code=US' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |request_id|string| The log ID of the request, which uniquely identifies a request.| |data|object|Returned data.| #|file_types|object[]|A list of verification document types you can upload for the specified country or region (`region_iso_code`).| ##|file_type_name|string|The name of the business verification document or personal identification document.
  • If you set `business_type` to `BUSINESS` in the request, this field represents the business verification document name.
  • If you set `business_type` to `INDIVIDUAL` in the request, this field represents the personal identification document name.
| ##|file_type_code|string|The code of the business verification document or personal identification document.
  • If you set `business_type` to `BUSINESS` in the request, this field represents the business verification document code.
  • If you set `business_type` to `INDIVIDUAL` in the request, this field represents the personal identification document code.
| ``` ### Example #### For business verification ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "file_types": [ { "file_type_code": "127724548", "file_type_name": "Documents issued by the IRS (Internal Revenue Service) showing the Employer Identification Number (EIN)" } ] } } (/code) ``` #### For individual identity verification ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "file_types": [ { "file_type_code": "5", "file_type_name": "Passport" }, { "file_type_code": "6", "file_type_name": "Driver's License" }, { "file_type_code": "131104004", "file_type_name": "Permanent Resident Card (Green Card)" }, { "file_type_code": "131104260", "file_type_name": "Passport Card" }, { "file_type_code": "131104516", "file_type_name": "State-issued Non-Driver ID" } ] } } (/code) ```
